race.description: Ladbrokes Place Extra To 10th Mdn Plate
race.comment: BEMM RIVER (2) was unplaced on debut then ran an improved race to be beaten in a photo here last time. Probably meets some better types this time but he has the talent to test this line-up, especially from the good draw. THE COMEDIAN (6) looks to have trialled up best of the first starters. Has won his past two and done so under light rides. He looks to have a bit of quality and draws well. WATTEN ASSETT (7) ran a third straight second before going for a break and returns here a gelding. Placed in a recent trial. Looks a definite winning chance. WINSILENCE (8) showed good early dash when resuming last start and held on well to finish 2 lengths back in third over 1013m at this track. Meeting a tougher field but on his best form he is capable of a big performance. ZOVOZO (14) is a three-year-old filly on debut from the stable of Emma-Lee & David Browne who has trialled up adequately and a good gate is sure to assist. Worth watching for a betting push.
